name: Bóng người trong Hồ Ký Ức
scene: A still immortal memory lake, VIEW FROM BEHIND a seated traveler on the LEFT foreground. The traveler touches a small carved jade memory stone; on the mirror-like water near CENTER a faint luminous reflection suggests an old childhood friendship, while mist covers a far pavilion ruin at RIGHT. One quiet white heron stands nearby. Lavender grey, pale jade, muted blue and ivory. Nostalgia and gentle melancholy, no horror, no giant moon.
